newsitem.title: USA: Ostex adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Ostex adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Ostex International Inc said it adopted a shareholder rights plan -- commonly known as a poison pill -- to protect it against a hostile takeover attempt.

The company said that under the plan it will issue one preferred stock purchase right as a non-taxable dividend for each share of common stock held. The company will issue the rights on January 27, it said. The rights expire January 2007.
The rights are designed to provide adequate time for the company's board and shareholders to evaluate any proposals, said the company, whose officials were not immediately available to comment.
